title: Network Support Technician
description:
Hi,

New Opportunity – Network Support Technician

We're working with a leading global tech organization that is looking for an experienced Network Support Technician to join their team in Guarulhos, Brazil.

Network Support Technician

Location: Guarulhos, Brazil

Overview

The Network Technician is responsible for installing, maintaining, monitoring, and troubleshooting an organization's network infrastructure. This role supports LAN, WAN, and wireless networks to ensure reliable connectivity, security, and optimal performance for users and business systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and maintain network hardware including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity issues related to TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, and switching.
  • Monitor network performance and respond to outages or degradation in service.
  • Support LAN, WAN, VPN, and WLAN environments.
  • Perform IP addressing, subnetting, and VLAN configurations.
  • Assist with network upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure refresh projects.
  • Maintain network cabling, patch panels, and labeling standards.
  • Implement and support basic network security measures such as access controls and VPN connectivity.
  • Document network diagrams, configurations, procedures, and incident resolutions.
  • Work with system administrators, security teams, and vendors to resolve escalated issues.
  • Provide Tier 1–2 network support and on-call support as required.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs).
  • Experience with enterprise network equipment (Cisco or equivalent).
  • Understanding of LAN/WAN and wireless networking concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with network cabling (Cat5e/Cat6, fiber basics).
  • Familiarity with network monitoring and ticketing tools.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues under pressure.
  • Experience with Active Directory and Group Policy basics.
  • Familiarity with Windows Server networking services.
  • Hands-on troubleshooting skills in enterprise environments.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Network+ or CCNA certification.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or multi-site environments.
  • Basic knowledge of firewalls, VPNs, and security best practices.
  • Experience with Windows Server networking and Active Directory.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic chance to work on a high-profile project in Guarulhos, BR.

title: Rust Developer
description:
About You

You are a senior software engineer who enjoys building high-performance, reliable, and secure systems. You're passionate about low-level efficiency, correctness, and modern software design, and you thrive in environments where performance, safety, and scalability truly matter.

You're looking for a role where you can influence technical decisions, work on challenging backend systems, and collaborate with strong engineering teams while continuously sharpening your Rust expertise.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience using Rust in production environments.
  • Solid understanding of Rust's ownership model, lifetimes, memory safety, and concurrency patterns.
  • Experience building high-performance backend services, APIs, or system-level components using Rust.
  • Strong knowledge of asynchronous programming in Rust (e.g., Tokio, async/await).
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs, gRPC, or other service communication patterns.
  • Familiarity with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) and data persistence strategies.
  • Experience with testing, debugging, and performance profiling in Rust.
  • Knowledge of Linux environments, networking fundamentals, and system-level concepts.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, clean code, and maintainable architectures.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance and reliable backend systems using Rust.
  • Build and optimize services with a strong focus on performance, safety, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, DevOps, product) to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technical decision-making.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable Rust code following best practices.
  • Debug complex issues related to concurrency, memory usage, and system performance.
  • Integrate Rust services with external systems, APIs, and data stores.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and continuous improvement of development processes.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation throughout the SDLC.
  • Mentor other engineers and share knowledge around Rust best practices when applicable.

  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)

Desired Experience

title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
description:
The Senior HR Business Partner will act as a strategic and operational partner to the business, supporting all HR functions in a hands-on and generalist manner. In addition to ensuring the execution of HR processes and policies, the Senior HRBP will play a leading role in the implementation of projects, development initiatives, engagement actions, and compliance with local regulations, ensuring alignment with regional and global strategies.

1. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Full-cycle recruitment for internal and external hires.
  • Partner with managers to define profiles and negotiate offer packages.
  • Ensure a positive onboarding experience, aligned with global standards.
  • Support market mapping and employer branding initiatives.

2. Learning & Development

  • Implement and monitor local and global training programs.
  • Support leadership and employee development programs.
  • Coordinate knowledge-sharing events and cultural initiatives.
  • Monitor and follow up on individual development plans.

3. Performance & Talent Management

  • Support the global performance cycle and talent programs.
  • Provide guidance to managers and employees on career development and feedback.
  • Conduct engagement surveys and exit interviews.

4. Compensation, Benefits & Payroll

  • Support administration of local benefits.
  • Liaise with external payroll providers to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Ensure adherence to labor legislation (vacations, terminations, timekeeping, leaves, etc.).
  • Conduct market benchmarking analyses.
  • Monitor HR budgets and actual monthly expenses.

5. Employee Relations

  • Serve as the first point of contact for employees and managers regarding HR matters.
  • Ensure compliance with labor laws and ethical standards.
  • Provide support on sensitive cases in partnership with legal advisors.
  • Conduct exit interviews and follow-up on critical cases.

6. Culture & Events

  • Design, develop, and lead HR events and initiatives: year-end parties, commemorative dates, ESG actions, and team-building activities.
  • Promote employee engagement initiatives and strengthen organizational culture.
  • Organize internal knowledge-sharing events and cultural activities (e.g., talks, workshops).
  • Foster a positive work environment aligned with ZIM's values.

7. Health, Safety & Compliance

  • Liaise with occupational health providers to ensure compliance with NR1 and other legal requirements.
  • Oversee occupational health and safety programs: pre-employment, periodic and termination exams, PCMSO and PGR.
  • Support internal and external audits (including SOX).
  • Ensure compliance with local labor and occupational health standards as well as global HR policies.

8. HR Operations & Analytics

  • Manage and update HR data in systems (HCM Oracle, ADP or others).
  • Extract and analyze HR metrics (headcount, turnover, absenteeism, etc.).
  • Prepare HR reports and presentations for regional and global leadership.
  • Propose continuous improvements in processes and policies.

Requirements

  • Resume must be in English.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Psychology, HR Management or related fields.
  • Experience in multinational companies, nice to have.
  • Ability to operate both strategically and operationally.
  • Proven experience in project management and HR initiatives implementation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; HRIS experience preferred.
  • Advanced English; Spanish desirable.

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks.
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts.
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics.
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.

Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries, including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies.
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic.
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function, not just an operator.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you'll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that's just the beginning - here's what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you're well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)

$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position

About the Company

Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.

Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.

You'll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence: a small, elite group of engineers who are the "go-to" specialists when others can't solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.

The Role

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS.

This is not a traditional support role — you'll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You'll work on:

  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years' experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills

Who You Are

  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can't fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator, confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who's passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group

Why You'll Love It Here

Work fully remote from anywhere

Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Help Desk Technician
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The ICT Technician reports to the Network and Infrastructure Manager and is responsible for supporting our operation helping our clients in all IT services listed in our service catalog.

Needs to be able to help our clients in the first contact supporting all end-user technology (hardware, software or service) following the ICT Department guidelines.

The successful candidate is a customer service-oriented and hands-on professional who understands his role and responsibilities working on a critical Service Desk operation.

This position is best filled by someone who demonstrates an understanding of support routines and the priorities in an educational environment and the mission of an American International school. In addition, this technician is dedicated to student- and teaching-centered support, decision-making and prioritizing in both word and action.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities

-Provide technical support for faculty, staff, students and parents on the IT services supported by the ICT department. It includes, systems, softwares, accesses, desktops, laptops, printers, projectors, mobile devices, IP phones, access points and IoT devices;

-Execute the Check-In and Check-Out Process of faculty, staff, students and parents

-Primary point of contact for Tier 1 support calls. Be able to help our clients on the phone and using remote access tools;

-Show excellent problem-solving skills to develop and deploy technical and creative solutions to user issues.

-Respond to help requests via email, through a help desk interface, or over the phone. Register information related to the incident and determine the root cause of the problem. Develop methods and solutions to resolve the user's issue, and balance the flow of incoming support requests and escalations to other team members.

-Escalate tickets to IT specialists, passing on notes related to the problem, solutions that have been unsuccessful, and their understanding of the user's problem.

-Maintain clear and concise records of user issues with the IT services using these notes to diagnose and repair complex problems and provide their IT department with data highlighting problems reported by multiple users.

-Maintain accurate inventory of all IT equipment.

Experience

  • Experience working with hardware maintenance and printers.
  • Skills to troubleshoot network problems.
  • Experience supporting demanding clients.
  • Advanced English, both spoken and written - Desired

We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.

Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs), collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs.
  • Practice code versioning (Git), with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!

Requirements

  • Experience in a functional language like Elixir, Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases.
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing.
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin.
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices.
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).

Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Engenheiro de Dados Jr.
description:

  • Projetar e implementar modelos analíticos e estruturas de dados.

  • Experiência com ambientes de nuvem (desejável Azure).

  • Modelagem dimensional e otimização de consultas.
  • Uso de Git e práticas de DevOps/DataOps.

VAMOS TRANSFORMAR VIDAS COM EDUCAÇÃO POR MEIO DA TECNOLOGIA?

Somos uma empresa que transforma vidas com educação por meio da tecnologia oferecendo um ecossistema completo com soluções para estudantes, instituições de ensino e empresas.

Trabalhamos duro para oferecer a melhor experiência de aprendizagem digital contribuindo para remover obstáculos, ampliando o acesso à uma educação de qualidade e deixando nosso legado no mundo.

O UOL EdTech faz parte do Grupo UOL, uma empresa 100% brasileira e que revoluciona o universo digital desde 1996 e desse legado, carregamos a credibilidade, o pioneirismo e a inovação em nosso DNA.

Conheça nosso ecossistema

Oferecemos um ecossistema completo para educação que transforma vidas! Nossas verticais de negócio são:

  • Para Estudantes: oferecemos a maior plataforma de estudos online, facilitando diariamente o acesso ao conhecimento, empoderamento e transformando o futuro das pessoas. No Brasil, utilizamos a marca Passei Direto e no restante do mundo a marca Studenta.
  • Para Empresas: temos duas frentes de atuação, com a Learning.Rocks oferecemos uma solução completa para atender as necessidades de treinamento das empresas, unindo tecnologia e conteúdo multiformatos. Já com a Qulture.Rocks apoiamos empresas a destravarem o potencial dos seus times, com uma plataforma de gestão de pessoas e desempenho.
  • Para Instituições de Ensino: somos o parceiro tecnológico de grandes universidades nas ofertas de cursos de especialização 100% online, captando estudantes no Brasil e no mundo.

Somos apaixonados por educação e tecnologia

A tecnologia é nosso combustível estamos sempre em busca de soluções disruptivas e tecnológicas que nos ajudem a romper barreiras para levar nossas soluções em educação para qualquer canto do mundo!

O coletivo é mais forte que o indivíduo

Acreditamos na diversidade e pluralidade das pessoas para atingir resultados incríveis! Por isso, não fazemos distinção de pessoas com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual/afetiva, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética.

E tem mais, dá uma olhada:

  • No dress code: o importante é você usar o que te faz bem.
  • #TáDeParabéns: Day off no aniversário.
  • Baby gift: presente para recém-nascidos.

Saiba como funciona nosso processo seletivo

Nem todos os processos seguem o mesmo formato. Mas, a grande maioria segue um andamento parecido:

  • Entrevista com o time de Recrutamento & Seleção.

Pedimos que acompanhe sua candidatura por aqui e na sua caixa e-mail, sem esquecer de olhar o spam, combinado?

Vem ser #EdTecher!

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company's tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.

We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.

Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;

Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

Você consegue pegar uma ideia criativa e colocá-la em prática. Você desenvolve e entrega soluções que atendem às expectativas do cliente. Você se comunica de forma eficaz em diversos contextos: individualmente, em grupos pequenos ou grandes, e entre diferentes estilos e níveis hierárquicos.

title: Coordenador fiscal - Torre de faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:

Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa ("torre" de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.

Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.

Qualificações & requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte de liderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;

Competências comportamentais:

  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional ("hands-on");
  • Alta capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;

Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

description:

title: Network Engineer
description:

  • Monitor network performance using SolarWinds and escalate issues as needed.
  • Perform first-line network troubleshooting and resolve basic connectivity problems.
  • Contact Internet Service Providers (ISPs) for outage resolution and service coordination.
  • Assist in small-scale network deployments and configuration tasks.
  • Support the maintenance and documentation of Aruba switches and wireless controllers.
  • Assist with Fortinet firewall configurations and basic security monitoring.
  • Support Infoblox DDI operations including DNS, DHCP, and IPAM tasks.
  • Document network changes and maintain accurate records for compliance and knowledge sharing.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to ensure service continuity.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network engineering.
  • English (fluent) and Portuguese

title: Desenvolvedor .NET Sênior com Inglês
description:
Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq!

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- Conhecimento sólido em programação orientada a objetos e aplicação de princípios SOLID;

- Prática com padrões de design (Design Patterns);

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.

The Senior Project Manager is a transit industry veteran with a proven track record for leading the design, development, and implementation of Transit ITS projects. A dynamic leader, with excellent communications, interpersonal skills, acknowledged industry experience, the Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading project teams, managing resources, adherence to schedule performance, and managing the financials of projects throughout the full development life cycle. This also includes management of issues, risks, and project change requests to ensure successful and on-time project delivery.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Manage all aspects of a project, including planning, organization, and implementation of project activities, ensuring projects are managed in line with scope, budget, schedule, and quality standards
  • Provide overall project communication to stakeholders and meet project requirements and stakeholder expectations
  • Serves as primary point of contact with the customer of the project and keeps customer appraised of project progress
  • Manage and oversee all project activities, such as issue tracking and risk mitigation, facilitating project team meetings and preparing/delivering status reports
  • Work closely with cross functional departments (Deployment, Engineering Design, Installation, and Field Service) to ensure successful execution of projects
  • Established a working relationship with the customer's stakeholders and maintains good communication correspondence with customer.
  • Assembles appropriate team to meet and exceed project expectations
  • Provide direction and control of work performed in the framework of project, including monitoring the critical path and implementation of appropriate corrective actions
  • Coordinate and perform review of the project deliverables, software and hardware, and report on project performance
  • Manage and plan with the Systems Engineering and Product/Engineering team leads for technical review of system design and documentation with the customer
  • Establishes a project plan and schedules according to established company practices, polices, tools and templates.
  • Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to program master plans
  • Manages financial schedule performance of assigned projects
  • Maintains and keeps scheduling of assigned projects and communicates schedule changes as necessary
  • Manages full lifecycle of project and ensures each aspect of the project is completed
  • Manages procurement of equipment and materials necessary to execute on projects
  • Develops subcontractors' scopes of work, executes subcontracts and manages subcontractors as may be necessary
  • Coordinates with Sales and Account Managers to further sales opportunities
  • May coordinate proposal preparation, including standards of work and specifications, estimation of product and service costs.
  • May participate in negotiation and administration of contracts
  • Travel required for onsite at customers facility up to 40%
  • Adheres to company processes and policies.

Skills Required:

  • 10+ years' experience as a Project Manager in a technical or engineering environment with a focus on delivering projects to external customers.
  • B.S. Degree and or 5+ Years as a Project Manager in and ITS environment
  • PMP certification or equivalent preferred.
  • Experience in transit industry.
  • Strong computer skills, including MS Office Suite, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook as well as ability to learn new software programs such as Microsoft Dynamics AX
  • Strong team building and leadership skills. Ability to lead the team.
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Strong time management skills and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong verbal and written communications, presentation, and persuasive skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong negotiation and influence skills

title: (Contract) Psychologist / Psychoanalyst
description:
Part-Time Mental Health Therapist-Hybrid

Location: Ibirubá, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil (**Please do NOT apply if you are not located within 20 miles/ 32 km of Ibirubá)

Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is the leading comprehensive mental health benefit for employers. We help employees understand their mental health issues and connect with best-in-class providers to get the right treatment at the right time.

From early detection to full recovery, Spring Health is the only clinically validated solution in the market proven to be more effective than traditional mental healthcare. By combining the latest technology with vetted providers, we help engage 1 in 3 employees, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs. We are an award-winning, passionate, and mission-driven team with the support of leaders in psychiatry.

We are seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed psychotherapists to join our provider network and deliver care with a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform that puts patient outcomes first.

What You'll Do

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing as many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client's needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.

Who you are

  • You have an unrestricted license to practice counseling (as a Psychologist or Psychoanalyst) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring licensed supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure).
  • You are available to offer some amount of monthly in-person availability for Spring Health members in Ibirubá, Brazil.
  • You have a minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience.
  • You're comfortable with technology and are telehealth competent.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master's level clinical care navigators.

If you are applying to a hybrid role, please be aware that your own office space will be required.

Why you'll like working with Spring Health

  • You'll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you'll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!

In addition to finding people who are truly excellent at what they do, we take our values at Spring Health seriously:

Members Come First We are genuine member advocates.

Move Fast to Change Lives We build with urgency and intention.

Take Ownership We extend trust and hold ourselves accountable.

Embrace Diverse Teams & Perspectives We find strength in the diversity of cultural backgrounds, ideas, and experiences.

Science Will Win We will achieve impact by innovation and evidence based frameworks.

Candor with Care We are open, honest and empathetic.

Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.

Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Bolsista Doutor em Engenharia - PizzattoLog - Programação Perfeita | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR

Descrição

Sobre a NARI Brasil

A NARI Brasil é uma empresa integrante ao NARI Group Corporation, líder no fornecimento de equipamentos para o setor de energia elétrica na China. Fundado em 1973, o grupo NARI dedica-se a oferecer tecnologias de ponta.

Desde sua fundação no Brasil em 2013 com suas operações em Sorocaba-SP, a NARI Brasil tem se destacado no desenvolvimento e comercialização de sistemas de controle e proteção de subestações, com foco em soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.

Oportunidade

Comprador(a)

Buscamos um(a) Comprador(a) para compor nosso time do escritório em Sorocaba-SP. Se você tem perfil proativo, adaptabilidade e resolução de problemas, essa pode ser a chance perfeita para o seu desenvolvimento.

Requisitos

  • Superior nas áreas Administração, Contabilidade, Negócios Internacionais, Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos na área de compras no setor de energia elétrica ou formação complementar voltada para a área de energia elétrica;
  • Experiência sólida em compras diretas, negociações de contratos e processos de importação;
  • Inglês intermediário para conversação diária;

Descrição das Atividades

  • Executar todos os processos de compras de acordo com as regras, políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos;
  • Executar a estratégia para o cumprimento dos objetivos estratégicos, indicadores e metas da área de compras;
  • Prospectar, desenvolver e homologar fornecedores de materiais e serviços, nacionais e internacionais, de acordo com o procedimento de homologação de fornecedores;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento diário das operações de compras (requisições, pedidos de compra, entregas, pagamentos) garantindo o cumprimento do negociado;
  • Negociar toda e qualquer proposta com fornecedores, garantindo o abastecimento da empresa com as melhores condições de preço, prazo e qualidade;
  • Manter o registro de fornecedores de materiais e serviços atualizado;
  • Participar das reuniões e discussões técnico-comerciais para equalizar valores e atender aos requisitos específicos do projeto, tanto na aquisição de serviços quanto de materiais, nacionais ou estrangeiros;

  • Realizar o controle do orçamento dos projetos, mantendo as despesas incorridas menores ou iguais ao orçamento;

title: Bolsista Doutor - Forx - Melhoria Contínua em Inovação no Setor Agrícola | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A FORX Peças Agrícolas vive um momento estratégico de modernização e busca um profissional capaz de iniciar e conduzir integralmente um projeto de desenvolvimento técnico na área de engenharia mecânica.

A oportunidade envolve atuar no desenho e detalhamento de peças e equipamentos, criação de gabaritos, matrizes e modelos em SolidWorks, além de contribuir para soluções que melhorem a precisão, qualidade e eficiência dos processos produtivos.

O profissional será responsável por estruturar, desenvolver e acompanhar o projeto do início ao fim e permanecer, aplicando conhecimentos técnicos para otimizar processos, reduzir custos e fortalecer a competitividade da empresa no setor metalmecânico.

Se você tem perfil analítico, experiência em projetos mecânicos e deseja liderar um projeto com impacto real, esta oportunidade é ideal para você.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado em Engenharia Mecânica

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Melhoria Contínua em Inovação no Setor Agrícola

Principais Atividades:

  • Mapear, estruturar e padronizar processos do setor comercial, incluindo vendas internas, externas e digitais;
  • Elaborar e implementar estratégias comerciais voltadas ao aumento de faturamento e expansão de mercado;
  • Realizar análises de dados, indicadores (KPIs) e inteligência de mercado para apoiar a tomada de decisão;
  • Identificar oportunidades de novos mercados, canais de distribuição e oportunidades de exportação;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de negociação e apoiar a gestão do relacionamento com clientes e parceiros;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento e profissionalização da equipe comercial, apoiando treinamento e acompanhamento de desempenho;
  • Avaliar e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos, integrando práticas de inovação e gestão da mudança;
  • Apoiar estudos de viabilidade relacionados a importação e exportação, quando aplicável;
  • Atuar em conjunto com diferentes áreas da empresa, promovendo alinhamento institucional e fluidez operacional.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Experiência em projetos de peças e matrizes;
  • Experiência em Automação industrial;
  • Conhecimento de PCP e gestão de engenharia.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Profissional criativo;
  • Habilidade em transformar ideias em projetos reais de forma eficiente;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver soluções com foco em economia de recursos.

Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho: Presencial

Local: Toledo/PR

Soft Skills: Liderança, Autogestão, Trabalho em Equipe, Autonomia, Criatividade.

description:

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Gerar impacto positivo no mundo dos alimentos, agricultura e produtos industriais, avançando para um futuro sustentável para toda a humanidade.

Unimos nossos recursos naturais, a dedicação de uma equipe talentosa e nossa capacidade tecnológica para ampliar a produção de alimentos, garantir sua qualidade, viabilizar uma agricultura e uma produção industrial sustentáveis e proteger o meio ambiente.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you're curious about AI/ML integrations even if you're not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Finance Manager - Brazil
description:
Job Title: Finance Manager(Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time (8 hours/day)

Work Location: Manaus, Brazil

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Finance Manager to oversee the company's overall financial strategy and planning, evaluate financial performance, risks, and investment opportunities. The ideal candidate will possess comprehensive knowledge of finance, accounting, and business principles, with strong strategic thinking and leadership skills to drive profitability and return on investment.

This role involves close collaboration with senior executives to develop budgets and coordinate strategy execution, ensuring efficient and compliant financial operations. We are looking for an analytical and strategic leader to join our fast-paced and growing team.

Key Responsibilities

- Oversee all aspects of cash management, investments, insurance, budgeting, and financial reporting. Drive the implementation of financial strategy and support team hiring and development.

- Lead the development of annual operating, capital, and program budgets, and provide regular reporting and analysis.

- Supervise daily accounting, recording, reporting, and internal control activities to ensure cash flow alignment with operational needs.

- Establish and implement financial best practices and tools to strengthen fiscal management, project coordination, cross-functional communication, and workflow efficiency.

- Monitor national and local financial regulations to ensure ongoing compliance.

- Provide strategic financial guidance to support business decision-making and achievement of company objectives.

- Mentor and develop the finance team to enhance professional capabilities and execution effectiveness.

- Contribute to the formulation of overall business strategy from a financial perspective.

- Develop and monitor operating budgets to ensure financial targets are met and to forecast future trends.

- Implement an internal audit program to ensure compliance with financial and statutory requirements.

- Oversee external contracts and supplier performance to ensure adherence to service agreements.

- Develop and maintain financial policies and procedures to ensure sound financial management and risk control.

- Report to management and stakeholders, offering advice and insights for key business decisions.

- Conduct finance-related training to uplift team competencies.

- Prepare financial reports related to budgets, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and expenses.

- Analyze market trends and competitor activities.

- Assess and manage financial risks, developing appropriate mitigation strategies.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with senior management, external partners, and stakeholders.

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree or professional certification (e.g., CPA) is preferred.

- Substantial experience in the finance industry (suggested 10+ years), with familiarity with SUFRAMA regulations and the tax benefits/obligations of the Zona Franca de Manaus.

- Demonstrated experience in product cost analysis and strategy development.

- Experience in mergers & acquisitions and investor relations is a plus.

- Strong English communication skills (written and spoken) to collaborate effectively with international teams. Proficiency in Spanish is an advantage.

- Excellent leadership and team management abilities, with a high degree of integrity and professionalism.

- Outstanding verbal, written, and visual communication skills.

- Solid understanding of advanced accounting principles, tax planning, and regulatory compliance.

- Knowledge of non-traditional fundraising channels and capital raising methods.

- Familiarity with foreign exchange risk management mechanisms.

- Proficient in using relevant information technology and financial software.

What We Offer

- Competitive compensation and incentive package.

- An international working platform with opportunities for professional growth.

- An open, inclusive, and collaborative company culture.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

description:

title: Front Desk Representative
description:
This position needs relocation to the Grand Cayman.

The Front Desk Agent will be the first point of contact for our guests, setting the tone for their stay and ensuring a seamless and memorable experience. This individual will be responsible for managing front desk operations, providing exceptional service, and ensuring the smooth execution of guest transactions and requests.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Guest Reception and Service:
  • Welcome guests and provide a warm and sincere welcome to the property.
  • Respond to guest inquiries, resolve issues promptly, and provide recommendations on property activities, amenities, and services.
  • Assist guests with booking and checking out of rooms, as well as handling any guest-related requests.
  • Check-in, Check-out, and Room Assignments:
  • Process check-in and check-out procedures efficiently and accurately, ensuring guest rooms are assigned according to property standards.
  • Ensure that all necessary documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Communication and Coordination:
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues and management to resolve issues, share guest feedback, and coordinate special requests.
  • Collaborate with other departments to provide a seamless and memorable experience for guests.
  • Payment and Billing:
  • Process guest transactions accurately and efficiently, using a point-of-sale system.
  • Handle guest billing, payment processing, and any discrepancies that may arise.
  • Inventory Management and Stock Control:
  • Maintain accurate records of front desk supplies, ensuring that stock levels are maintained and costs are controlled.
  • Report any discrepancies or issues related to supplies and inventory management to management.
  • Technology and Systems:
  • Familiarize yourself with property management systems (PMS), including check-in and check-out processes, guest profiles, and room assignments.
  • Ensure accuracy and efficiency when using PMS and other technology tools.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a front desk or concierge role in an independent luxury property.
  • Strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards and practices.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong guest relationships.
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with property management systems (PMS) and other technology tools.
  • Flexibility to work varying shifts, including weekends and holidays as required.

Skills and Attributes:

  • Friendly and approachable demeanour.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and composed in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong communication and language skills (English required, additional languages an asset).
  • Proficiency in MS Office and ability to learn PMS systems.

title: Lead Backend Engineer (Python) — Silicon Valley Healthcare AI Company (Remote, Latin America)
description:
You have been the go-to engineer on your team — the one others turn to when things get hard. You don't wait for tickets; you figure out what needs to be built and you build it. Now you want a role where that's the expectation, not the exception.

We're hiring for that role. Remote, anywhere in Latin America.

Areti Health is a fast-growing Silicon Valley healthcare technology company. We have built the only full-service clinical trial patient recruitment AI agent. Backed by leading venture capital firms with a $6.6M funding round just closed, we are on a mission to transform clinical research through technology that allows pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies to bring their therapies to patients faster and save lives.

We achieve industry-leading conversion rates: up to 10x improvement over human-driven processes with up to 8x operational cost reduction. Coupled with our seamless medical record access and mass outreach capabilities, we compress recruitment timelines from many months to a few weeks across multiple therapeutic areas.

Our AI-first system matches prospective patients, answers their questions based on clinical trial documentation using voice and chat AI, schedules appointments, collects patient information, runs pre-qualification questionnaires, assists with patient onboarding, nurtures scheduled patients, and integrates with research site systems – all fully autonomously. We work with some of the largest US clinical research players, including the #1 commercial clinical research organization ($16B in revenue), the #1 academic clinical research organization (trials at 1,100 sites), and the #1 clinical research site network.

You will join a team of 20, working closely with the founder who brings a prior $4B healthcare technology exit, Y Combinator founder experience, a Stanford PhD, and three Silicon Valley CTO stints.

We offer competitive salary, stock options, and paid time off.

What you will do

  • Scale the product to support thousands of clinical trials
  • Work directly on AI applications daily
  • Design, develop, and maintain reliable, simple, and efficient Python services
  • Architect and implement robust backend systems that handle sensitive healthcare data
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver solutions that delight customers
  • Deeply integrate with clinical trial management and other systems
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Drive technical and product decision-making and help shape our engineering roadmap and architecture decisions

Note: This role does not involve training ML models.

Requirements

  • You are excited about our mission: getting novel therapies to patients faster
  • 5+ years of Python experience you're proud of — across multiple projects, systems, or problem domains. We value growth and range, not the same year repeated five times.
  • Track record of end-to-end ownership: scoping, building, shipping, and maintaining
  • You are an AI-native developer — you ship features using Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools daily, not occasionally
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking initiative. You figure out what needs to be done – not expect to be told what to do
  • Self-directed and low-maintenance thanks to your strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Background as a software engineer first — we're looking for candidates who have focused their careers on building and shipping production software, rather than transitioning from data science, research, or other adjacent fields
  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent

Nice to have

  • AWS infrastructure experience
  • Experience with large language models in production, where you personally wrote prompts and used GenAI tooling, such as prompting or guardrail libraries

title: Engenheiro de Software Full Stack SR
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.

Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.

Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.

Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.

O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

Sobre a área de Engenharia

O Engenheiro de Software Full Stack terá como desafios propor soluções para o marketplace com o foco em facilitar a vida do nosso cliente para usar nosso sistema de forma eficiente e satisfatória para realizar compras e continuar com nosso cliente ao longo da jornada.

Seu papel:

  • Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter as funcionalidades que visam experiência do usuário;
  • Projetar e suportar a implementação de APIs inovadoras e escaláveis e a interface visual para uma melhor usabilidade tanto no desktop (web) quanto em mobile (tablets/celulares) para transformar o setor de materiais de construção;
  • Construir um código com qualidade e testável unitariamente;
  • Construir e manter testes automatizados end to end;
  • Trabalhar no modelo ágil para garantir a velocidade e qualidade do negócio, influenciando os times;
  • Propor soluções disruptivas para melhorar a qualidade do código em todo o time.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em C# e Python com DRF;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Web com frameworks javascript (desejável VUE);
  • Experiência com arquitetura em microserviços (importante o conhecimento em Kubernetes;
  • Experiência em mensageria (RabbitMQ);
  • Experiência no uso de cache (Redis);
  • Experiência sistemas de autenticação (desejável Auth0);
  • Experiência com banco de dados SQL e NoSQL (desejável PostgreeSQL, SQL Server e MongoDB).

Se isso tudo faz sentido pra você, o próximo passo é seu. Vem ser Construtor(a) com a gente no maior Ecossistema da Construção Civil! ️

Nosso processo seletivo e o compromisso com a Diversidade:

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.

Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil! ️

Benefícios de ser um Construtor(a) na #Juntos

Por aqui, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é tão importante quanto alcançar resultados. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar sua saúde, bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida — dentro e fora do trabalho.

Remuneração variável: reconhecemos resultados de forma justa e transparente.

title: IT Data Engineer Specialist
description:

  • Atuar como referência técnica para engenheiros de dados, promovendo boas práticas, padrões e mentoria.

  • Avaliar e definir tecnologias, ferramentas e padrões de arquitetura.
  • Otimizar custos, performance e confiabilidade em ambientes cloud.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de dados estratégicas.

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior ou Especialista.
  • Amplo conhecimento e experiência na plataforma Databricks
  • Domínio de SQL avançado e programação (Python e/ou Scala).
  • Experiência com Big Data (Spark necessário, Kafka, Flink ou similares desejáveis).
  • Vivência com cloud Azure.
  • Conhecimento em Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquiteturas modernas (Lakehouse).
  • Experiência com orquestração (Datafactory, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Práticas de engenharia de software (CI/CD, versionamento, testes).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados analítica.
  • Experiência com governança, qualidade de dados e segurança.

Habilidades e competências:

  • Habilidade de liderança técnica e colaboração.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Visão estratégica e senso de responsabilidade.
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Curiosidade, autonomia e foco em melhoria contínua.

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. description:

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina

Full time

You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you'll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. Preferred Skills:

  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

title: Técnico (a) Especializado (a) De Manutenção Mecânica
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

  • Executar planos de ação em manutenções preventivas, corretivas e preditivas em máquinas, equipamentos e veículos utilizados nas operações florestais, conforme planos e procedimentos técnicos;
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos de falhas mecânicas, hidráulicas, pneumáticas e eletromecânicas, identificando causas e propondo soluções;
  • Efetuar ajustes, reparos, substituições de componentes e regulagens técnicas, assegurando o correto funcionamento dos equipamentos;

  • Registrar informações técnicas de manutenção, falhas e intervenções realizadas, conforme sistemas e controles internos;
  • Cumprir e zelar pelas normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade, garantindo a execução segura das atividades.

Requisitos:

  • CNH definitiva B;
  • Formação superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Possuir conhecimento técnico em manutenção mecânica, sistemas hidráulicos, pneumáticos, leitura e interpretação de manuais técnicos.

title: Analista Tributário Pleno
description:
A J&T Express é conhecida como uma das maiores empresas do setor de transportes de logística, entrega expressa, armazenamento e cadeia de suprimentos. Estamos presentes em 13 países, como Indonésia, Vietnã, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia, Cambodja, Singapura, China, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes Unidos, México e Brasil. Todos os dias fornecemos aos nossos clientes uma experiência de entrega expressa de excelente qualidade e eficiência, altamente confiável, trazendo mais benefícios às pessoas e fazendo com que elas aproveitem as transformações da economia digital.

Nossos números: 240 centros de transferências de larga escala; 1.000 equipamentos de triagem inteligente; 23.000 pontos de distribuição; mais de 400.000 colaboradores. Nossos serviços atingem 2,5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Venha construir um futuro melhor conosco!

Posição: Analista Tributário Pleno

Descrição da posição:

  • Apuração e controle do ICMS nas prestações de serviços de transporte intermunicipal e interestadual;
